gen-fs-oswald-gf-headland-one: Oswald packs its rows tight and speaks with confidence, while Headland One spaces its rounded, gently shaded letters well apart. One hits hard; the other settles in.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Authoritative from the first line, Oswald stands tight and sturdy. Hedvig Letters Serif adds a tall, classic serif body with open curves, and that shift in lowercase height is what keeps the pair interesting.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lisu-bosa: Oswald runs its lines tightly knit and strong, with little modulation, above Lisu Bosa's sturdy lowercase and swelling curves. The two trade bluntness for warmth.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-marcellus-sc: Oswald brings a confident, tightly knit heading over Marcellus SC, whose pulled-back terminals and mellow thick-thin shifts feel literary. Reading on would feel dignified and unhurried.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-montagu-slab: Tight, strong and sure of itself. Oswald sets the tone with compressed rows, and Montagu Slab follows with a sizable x-height and a text serif's gentle weight shifts, so a longer passage would read comfortably on screen.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Noto Serif Hentaigana keeps its curves open and its small letters nearly as tall as capitals, with visible but subtle stroke modulation. Oswald is best at forceful, compact headings; the body font is best at refined, traditional text.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-ovo: Ovo has a tall middle band and thins that run only slightly lighter than its thicks, giving each word a soft shading. And Oswald, tight and confident, supplies the punch Ovo's quiet authority needs.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-poltawski-nowy: Traditional in spirit, Poltawski Nowy sits plainly beneath Oswald's tightly knit, confident display lines, a literary classic serif body against a strong heading. Shrink Oswald and that strength would fade.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-slabo-27px: Compact, strong headings meet roomy curves. Oswald is at its best being bold and confident up top, while Slabo 27px does its best work in a tight-set, dignified, editorial body.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-vesper-libre: Vesper Libre brings a bookish, refined serif body, plain in its build, under a heading with real muscle. But Oswald's tightly knit, confident rows are the strongest quality here, giving the page its backbone.
